checks.evidence: The intersection is Predicate.meet, so it means both predicates at the same source point. The imported image uses an explicit source witness and equality to the image point.
The contract has arbitrary source/target universes, f, predicates p/q and every target y; both image membership proofs may initially have different witnesses.

The sole substantive hypothesis is the explicitly quantified injectivity hf : ∀ a b, f a=f b → a=b. The forward-only helper correctly omits hf, and the separate surjective helper explicitly requests surjectivity.
JL028 states a full iff between the image of p∧q and the conjunction of the two images, rather than merely the generally valid forward inclusion.

The reverse proof obtains a and b mapping to y, applies hf to hay.trans hby.symm, transports q b to q a, and returns a single shared witness. The preimage recovery and inclusion-reflection helpers reuse this same injective identification.

Read specs/JL-028.md, contracts/JL028.lean, and JonnyLean/Logic/InjectiveImages.lean in full, including all 5 explicitly named source theorems (image_meet_subset, image_meet_of_injective, preimage_image_of_injective, image_reflects_inclusion, image_preimage_of_surjective).
